scope: Primary-source feasibility/overlap audit for candidate46, not an exhaustive novelty search

papers.title: OverFeat: Integrated Recognition, Localization and Detection using Convolutional Networks
papers.authors: Pierre Sermanet; David Eigen; Xiang Zhang; Michael Mathieu; Rob Fergus; Yann LeCun
papers.metadata_and_download_provider: Paper Search search_arxiv exact title and download_arxiv exact version
papers.reviewed: Multiscale/sliding-window classification discussion and Figure3: overlapping crops duplicate work; image-wide convolutions share extraction; multiple pooling offsets recover finer alignment.
papers.overlap: Sharing convolutions across overlapping image windows and handling subsampling phase already have explicit prior art. Neither feature reuse nor enumerating phases can be presented as a new contribution.
papers.boundary: OverFeat does not establish exact equivalence between the project's independently resized/padded crops and a single larger feature atlas.

papers.title: Streaming convolutional neural networks for end-to-end learning with multi-megapixel images
papers.authors: Hans Pinckaers; Bram van Ginneken; Geert Litjens
papers.metadata_and_download_provider: Paper Search search_arxiv matched title and download_arxiv exact version
papers.reviewed: III methods introduction, III-A forward streaming, strided-convolution extension, and III-D limitations: overlap/edge handling, checkpointing cost and nonlocal operations.
papers.overlap: Exact tiled convolution, required overlap and boundary treatment are established. Memory savings do not imply a speedup.
papers.boundary: The paper concerns streaming the SAME input lattice; it does not remove independent crop resize phases. Its training-time BatchNorm limitation should not be misreported as a limitation of eval-mode frozen BatchNorm.

candidate_difference: Candidate46 only tests a necessary geometric condition for direct single-atlas integer slicing of this project's unchanged four views. No new algorithm, achieved speedup or novelty is asserted.
zotero_status: Both exact-version PDFs and extracted texts saved locally via Paper Search. No new Zotero imports claimed; callable Zotero tools unavailable in the current exposed tool inventory.
